title: Tower Heights
prompt:
**Description:** A skyline has n towers with heights h_1..h_n. In one
second you may pick any tower and change its height by 1. Find the
**minimum total seconds** to make all towers equal, and print the common
height achieving it. If several heights achieve the same minimum, print
the smallest one.

**Input:** Line 1: n (1 <= n <= 10^5). Line 2: n heights (0 <= h_i <= 10^9).
**Output:** Line 1: minimum total change. Line 2: the optimal height
(smallest if several tie).

**Example:** `3` / `1 2 4` -> the median 2 gives 1+0+2 = 3 seconds;
height 3 also gives 3, so print the smaller: `2`.

tests.name: sample
tests.hint: Median minimizes sum of absolute differences; tie 2 vs 3, smaller wins.

tests.name: single
even tie
